name: kpi-tracker
description: Records and shows every measurable Claude Code usage KPI (tokens, cost, context, rate limits, tools, code, git, permissions, subagents), stored per project and session: live band, panel, /kpi with filters, HTML report and CSV/JSON export. In English or Italian.

language.title: Language / Lingua
language.description: Language of the band, panel, /kpi, HTML reports and CSV/JSON exports: en = English, it = italiano. `/kpi … --lang it|en` overrides it for one command.

dataDir.title: KPI data folder
dataDir.description: Where to store the KPIs. Empty = <Claude Code config folder>/kpi. During development use a separate folder so test data does not mix with real data.

reportDir.title: Reports and exports folder
reportDir.description: Where to save HTML reports and CSV/JSON exports. Empty = _reports and _exports in the data folder. On Linux snap and flatpak browsers cannot read hidden folders: with a visible folder (e.g. ~/Documents/kpi) the report opens straight from there.

fullName.title: Name for export files
fullName.description: Name and surname in the CSV/JSON export file names, e.g. "Mario Rossi" gives kpi_mario_rossi_2026-11.csv (lower case, no accents, spaces become _). Empty = the name in git config user.name; without either, the files have no name.

categoriesFile.title: Activity categories file
categoriesFile.description: JSON file with the rules of the activity categories (a keyword in the git branch name gives the category, see the README). Empty = categorie.json or categories.json in the KPI data folder; without a file the categories are off.

buildCommands.title: Custom build commands
buildCommands.description: Your own build commands, comma-separated: a program or the start of a command line, e.g. "./build.sh, make dist, npm run package:all". They count as builds whatever the built-in rules say.

testCommands.title: Custom test commands
testCommands.description: Your own test commands, comma-separated, e.g. "./run-tests.sh, npm run check:all". They count as tests whatever the built-in rules say.

streamTiming.title: Per-request metrics (TTFT)
streamTiming.description: Hooks the response stream to measure time to first token, latency and tokens of each request. Turn it off if you notice slowdowns.

autoUpdate.title: Automatic updates
autoUpdate.description: auto = installs new versions compatible with your Claude Code by itself; avviso (or notify) = only reports them (install with /kpi update); off = no check. A version that requires a newer Claude Code is never installed: a warning appears.
